purpose: Capture reusable engineering opinions as local-only candidate context without turning opinions into repository law, execution authority, personal history, or a second work queue.

promotion.rule: A candidate opinion becomes repository authority only through a separately reviewed change to the actual canonical doctrine, skill, ADR/spec, validator, policy, or implementation owner.

proofCeiling: Local deterministic record/search behavior, state-path resolution, fail-closed malformed-state handling, and repository contract/routing validation only. It does not prove opinion correctness, promotion quality, cross-agent sync, provider memory, Drive/GitHub publication, or runtime adoption.
